form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Born-digital typed fillable form. Boxes B, C and F are printed as a COMPOUND value - '94009.26 +Inkind 666.67' - the filer wrote the cash figure plus a separate in-kind figure in the same cell; both are retained verbatim in the normalized slots rather than being summed or split (no arithmetic performed). Box A is a typed '0'. The form prints no political-party field. Signature is redacted upstream by the county (black bar); the printed Date and Date of Report (6/16/26) survive. The cover page's own Page box reads '2' although this is the first page of the rendered PDF.

notes: index.csv office 'County Commission Seat A' AGREES with the page face. The OCR locator's variant_guess was 'legacy_colAB'; the filing is in fact the modern Box A-F form (v. 12.23).
